assets.frozen_description: MARA, 34, sharp jawline, straight nose, dark brown eyes, no glasses. Copper-red bob, straight, jaw-length, side part on the left. 5'7", lean. Olive bomber jacket, black t-shirt, dark jeans, worn white sneakers. Small silver hoop earrings. Faint scar through the left eyebrow.
Classic straight-handle umbrella, solid poppy red, no pattern, wooden handle. Fully open, 100cm canopy.
Covered night market alley: canvas awnings, neon signs in red/gold/teal overhead, wet asphalt reflecting light, dumpling cart mid-alley on the right with steam.
